description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/txn-xproc-cascade-delete-vs-pending-child-edit: there was no final read after B's Update and close, so whether 999 persisted was unanswered. On r-def-cat-txn-rel-accdb: process B opens a dynaset on ChildCD, calls Edit on the first row and sets V = 999 (not updated). Process A runs DELETE FROM Parent WHERE ID = 3 (R_CD cascades to ChildCD) without dbFailOnError, then reads Database.RecordsAffected, DBEngine.Errors (right before and after) and the rows of ChildCD and Parent. B then calls Update (DBEngine.Errors) and closes. A waits 7 s, calls DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache), reads the same rows, closes its Database, reopens the file read-only and reads the rows of ChildCD and Parent once more.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
